title: 4.6. Exception Handling & Defensive Engineering
summary: Safeguard programs from runtime crashes using try-except blocks, handle specific exceptions (ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, IndexError), and use else and finally clauses.
learningObjectives: Understand the difference between compile-time SyntaxError and runtime Exceptions.
Intercept errors using try and except blocks to ensure robust, defensive code.
Handle multiple specific exceptions and utilize finally for guaranteed cleanup.

sections.heading: 4.6.1 The try-except Defensive Architecture

knowledgeChecks.prompt: Which block in a try-except structure executes regardless of whether an exception occurred or not?
knowledgeChecks.explanation: The finally block is guaranteed to execute whether an exception was raised, handled, or absent.

recap: try-except traps runtime errors, preventing crashes and supporting defensive system engineering.
